answer: Resist sybils with staked reputation and slashing. Each agent locks collateral before its votes count, and peers attest to real work. A flood of cheap fake identities earns nothing because fresh agents must complete a slow proof-of-contribution first, like coral growing on a reef. When an agent colludes or double-votes, slashing melts its stake like ferrous metal in a furnace and pays honest witnesses. Every attestation sits on a basalt-hard on-chain log, so a banned operator who re-registers starts the climb from zero, making mass farming uneconomical.
